claims.title: Correct grossly faulty relative readings before reusing a source for constrained equilibria

quoted_fields.interface: One stable globally connected latent vector across all sampled modules/positions; genuine difference-sensor orientations and a supplied total count of distinct faulty edges, or the separately specified whole-group model. Honest noise needs valid deterministic component budgets. Later tasks additionally require global spatial Lipschitz ceilings, a common gauge, known feedback/load, m>0 and certified q=(||K||+a)/m<1, with the stated projection operation.
quoted_fields.failure: No probabilistic independence is required by the bounded-fault proofs. One instrument may corrupt several edges and thereby exceed an edge-count budget. The55scalar lower bound assumes exactly5 separately counted groups and pairwise differences, not arbitrary linear sensors or unlimited groups. Noisy path and scalar envelopes are outer, not sharp joint posteriors; only nonzero residuals in the exact synthetic fixture identify the two faults. One global offset is harmless for this fixed-dose operation; independent module offsets are not. Saved future-task labels reuse the same60 network/load cases, not independent physical systems. Vector/drift extensions and their528-label aggregate are outside accepted scope here.
